{{Quote|Many Hutt foods are quite delicious, including this "punky muffin" sandwich. A breakfast favorite on Nar Shaddaa, it features a Klatooine paddy frog sausage, Klatooine paddy frog sausage and a slice of jerba cheese on a Klatooine paddy frog sausage.|Dex's Diner menu, on the "Hungry Hutt" breakfast sandwich|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
A '''Klatooine paddy frog sausage''' was a type of [[Sausage/Legends|sausage]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> that shared its name with the [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibian]] [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Klatooine paddy frog/Legends|Klatooine paddy frogs]], found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] located in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref> It was one of the ingredients of [["Hungry Hutt" breakfast sandwich]]es, a [[Foodstuff/Legends|breakfast]] favorite on the Hutt Space [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. The [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwiches]] were eaten by members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] species. and were also sold at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Klatooine paddy frog sausage was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
